name: Medusa

abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Shattered: Yeni Zırh Kırma etkilerini engeller ve Armor Up etkilerinin yetenek doğruluğunu %200 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fervor: Giden hasar veren etkilerin yetenek doğruluğunu artırır.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): En büyük tehlike otomatik blok, ama sadece 3 fury varken aktif — nötralize/nötrleştirme bunu önler. İsabetli saldırı efektli şampiyon da işe yarar.
signatureAbility:
Living Strands
While at least 3 personal Fury Buffs are active, when Medusa would be struck twice by a Special Attack or struck twice within 0.7 seconds by a non-Heavy Basic Attack, she has a [30 - 100]% chance to remove any Stun effects on her and Auto-Block the attack.
Whenever Medusa inflicts Armor Shattered or gains a Fervor Buff, gain a True Accuracy Buff for 35 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: An enhanced immune system provides full Immunity to Poison.

abilitySections.title: Medium Attacks
content: If the Opponent is not Armor Shattered, 150% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff reducing Armor Rating by [485.29] for 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Fury Buffs - Max: 6
content: Every 3 seconds, while not at max stacks, Medusa gains a Fury Buff increasing Attack Rating by +[1,058.87].
The first 3 Fury Buffs are indefinite. The rest last 14 seconds, but are paused until Medusa reaches her max.

abilitySections.title: Armor Shattered
content: When the Opponent is suffering from at least 6 Armor Break Debuffs, they are replaced with an Armor Shattered Debuff and an Armor Break Debuff reducing Armor Rating by [5,107.14] for 35 seconds.
While Armor Shattered, this Champion's #Robot Opponents also suffer from shattered systems, which reduces Combat Power Rate, Ability Power Rate, and Ability Accuracy by -100%.
While the Opponent is Armor Shattered, Medusa's Light and Heavy Attacks gain a 50% chance to inflict an indefinite Bleed Debuff, dealing [222.92] Direct Damage per second until Armor Shattered ends.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit inflicts an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor Rating by [485.29] for 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit has a 60% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff dealing [4,458.4] Direct Damage over 2 seconds.
The final hit inflicts a Stun Debuff for 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflicts an Armor Shattered Debuff and an Armor Break Debuff, reducing the opponent's Armor Rating by [5,107.14] for 35 seconds.

If the Opponent is already Armor Shattered, instead refresh the duration of Armor Break and Armor Shattered on the Opponent and gain a Fervor Buff increasing Damaging Debuff Ability Accuracy by 100% for 35 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Living Strands
content: While at least 3 personal Fury Buffs are active, when Medusa would be struck twice by a Special Attack or struck twice within 0.7 seconds by a non-Heavy Basic Attack, she has a [30 - 100]% chance to remove any Stun effects on her and Auto-Block the attack.
Whenever Medusa inflicts Armor Shattered or gains a Fervor Buff, gain a True Accuracy Buff for 35 seconds.
